items.metric: Replies (week, three week run 14 to 7 to 5)
items.effect: At a 13.51% reply rate this is the third straight drop and it caps sample approvals and the creator posts that land three to four weeks later.
items.action: Lift DM volume from 37 to 90 per week and add one follow-up touch to non-repliers before 2026-12-01.

items.effect: Videos rose 61.3% to 121 on 20% fewer creators, so affiliate GMV fell 18.7% and the top two creators now hold 36.7% of it.
items.action: Run a win-back DM to the 8 creators who posted last week but not this week with an expiring sample or bundle offer.

items.effect: Affiliate share dropped from 77.8% to 64.3%, leaving GMV Max ads to carry 75.6% of revenue at a 1.522 blended ROAS.
items.action: Hold affiliate at or above 70% of GMV by pairing the DM wave with a post reminder to creators holding samples.

items.metric: LIVE GMV (47 streams, 58,631 views, three week zero run)
items.effect: Three straight weeks of zero LIVE GMV means 58,631 views and the 47 stream roster are converting nothing.
items.action: Give the live roster a bundle script with a checkout call every 10 minutes or move the airtime to affiliate posts by 2026-11-30.

items.metric: BFCM Seat Cushion GMV Max ROAS (target 1.7)
items.effect: The campaign spent 274.95 dollars for 5 orders at 54.99 cost per order, 60.30 dollars underwater before COGS.
items.action: Pause Seat Cushion and Elevate Seat Cushion and move the budget to BFCM Screendoor at 2.061 ROAS.

items.metric: Sample requests expired (191 of 300, flag threshold 50%)
items.effect: Expiry, not creator interest, is the binding constraint: 51 fresh requests sit in To Review while only 3 of 300 requests reached Posted.
items.action: Clear the 51 To Review requests within 48 hours and set a 48 hour approval SLA with affiliate ops.
